[返回“高级语言程序设计课程”](<高级语言程序设计课程.qmd>)

将以下代码粘贴到命令行运行可以加快温大机房的电脑运行速度：

```
net stop mi-raysat_3dsmax8
net stop "Autodesk Licensing Service"
net stop ersvc
net stop helpsvc
net stop ssdpsrv
net stop themes
net stop sqlserveragent
net stop mssqlserver
net stop sqlbrowser
net stop mssql$sqlexpress
net stop sharedaccess
net stop webclient
net stop msftpsvc
net stop w3svc
net stop smtpsvc
net stop nntpsvc
net stop iisadmin
net stop w32time
net stop remoteregistry
net stop macprint
net stop lpdsvc
net stop spooler
net stop messenger
net stop wuauserv
net stop browser
net stop dfs
net stop lanmanserver
net stop bits
net stop messenger
net stop macfile
net stop alerter
net stop lanmanworkstation
net stop schedule
net stop trkwks
net stop lmhosts
net stop mdm
net stop policyagent
net stop alg
net stop dhcpserver
net stop dns
net stop ias
net stop licenseService
net stop mssearch
net stop wins
net stop ntlmssp
net stop simptcp
net stop snmp
net stop nvsvc
net stop msdtc
net stop wzcsvc
net stop cryptsvc
net stop dhcp
net stop C-DillaSrv
net stop C-DillaCdaC11BA

net stop "symantec antivirus"
net stop sens
net stop defwatch
net stop ccevtmgr
net stop ccsetmgr
net stop eventsystem
net stop ltdrv
net stop HrJobProcess
net stop KDSvrMgrService
net stop VMAuthdService
net stop VMnetDHCP
net stop "VMware NAT Service"
net stop KPfwSvc
net stop seclogon
```

下载 [pskill.exe](<assets/温大机房优化脚本/pskill.exe>) 并拷贝到Windows目录下，然后运行：

```
pskill raysat_3dsmax8s
pskill sqlmangr
pskill 360tray
pskill ati2evxx
pskill iccagent
pskill adskscsrv
pskill smax4pnp
```
